title: Universal Machine Rule Schema
description: The absolute essence of a machine-readable rule. No enums, no domain-specific fields. Just pure data.

version.description: Version of this specific rule dataset.

metadata.description: Completely open container for any context (e.g., { 'jurisdiction': 'EU', 'project': 'Apollo' }).

rules.description: The list of directives. Each item is a rule or standard.

type.description: Free text classification. Could be 'obligation', 'prohibition', 'standard', 'recipe', 'guideline' — completely open.

message.description: The human-readable output or description of the rule.

anchor_ref.description: A free string linking back to the human document (e.g., 'section:preamble' or 'urn:doctrine:principles').

evaluator_hint.description: A free string hinting how to evaluate this (e.g., 'regex', 'human_judgment', 'api_call'). No enum, just a hint.

parameters.description: Completely unconstrained key-value store. Holds anything: pattern, max_length, tax_rate, quorum, sensor_threshold.

conditions.description: Completely open container for activation logic (e.g., { 'if_env': 'production' } or { 'unless_holiday': true }).

rationale.description: Optional reasoning why this rule exists.

remediation.description: Optional suggestion on what to do if this rule is violated.
